title: Gideon and the Glasshouse
author: Noor Blackwood
blurb: Ada Winterbourne, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
